_purpose: Curated CI regression gate for Task 13's benchmark, fix round 1. Committed deliberately and NOT regenerated by bench.spec.ts on every run (see examples/e2e/bench.spec.ts) -- a baseline that updates itself every run could never catch a regression. frameWorkTimeP95Ms is the highest p95 observed across 9 independent baseline runs (3 Playwright process invocations x 3 in-process page loads each) at entityCount=500. toleranceMultiplier is deliberately generous (>10x the typical observed p95 of ~0.30ms) so ordinary machine noise never trips it; a real regression -- e.g. place() suddenly costing 10x, or the depthSort coalescing breaking -- would still clear it easily. This gate gauges REGRESSION against this plugin's own past behavior. It is NOT the 16.6ms/60fps aspirational threshold from the brief -- that comparison stays informational-only in the report, per the task's own rule against gating CI on an aspirational number.
machine: Apple M1 Max, 10 CPU cores, 64GB RAM, macOS 26.5.2, headless Chromium via Playwright 1.62.0, WebGL through SwiftShader (software, confirmed via WEBGL_debug_renderer_info) -- NOT a CI runner.
